name: Pipeliners - Seasonal Keyword Research 2026-10-13
body:
> Research · Pipeliners · 2026-10-13

# Summary
Fall 2026 seasonal blog research from live Google results (Kim's Chrome, Phoenix-localized) and Search Atlas `se_lookup_keyword`, Oct 13. Nothing estimated.

# Dropped ideas
- plumbing maintenance (1,238 / KD 13): navigational, wrong services.
- snowbird plumbing checklist: 0 volume (use as an angle only).
- slab leak detection (1,925 / KD 32): over KD 30 and owned by the leak detection page.

# Candidates
1. **signs of a slab leak** (396 / KD 21): verdict CANNIBAL, because /slab-leaks-phoenix/ (18117) already has the H2. Do it as the planned Nov 2 refresh of 18117 instead.
2. **what is a sewer scope inspection** (180 / KD 12): CLEAR. Keep "sewer scope inspection" (3,600 / KD 29) for the planned camera hub. Drafted the same day; see [Pipeliners - Blog - Sewer Scope Inspection](lib:brain-pipeliners-blog-sewer-scope-inspection).
3. **hydro jetting sewer line** (1,135 / KD 15): LOW RISK with conditions (no "Phoenix" plus "hydro jetting" in the title, link to /hydro-jetting/ and 15623, no vs-snaking section, no holiday-grease H2). Publish before Thanksgiving (Nov 26).

Each candidate lists supporting terms and Google People Also Ask questions. Seasonal angles already live: /sewer-line-maintenance/ (fall holiday post) and /sewer-smell-in-house/ (after summer).
